selected_cells: no high-QD cell flag and finite candidate_knee_cycle
qd_qc: Use existing knee quality_flags; preserve all other decreases and EOL crossings.
chargetime_primary: median of positive finite values; >60 mean sensitivity only
chargetime_source_definition: Time to charged capacity 0.88Ah; source fallback20min if threshold not found, previous value if <5min. Local generation version not proved.
chargetime_candidate_flags: 20min and repeated previous values are possible source-processing flags, not confirmed imputation; neither automatically excluded.
paired_unit: one file-local cell; repeated cycles not independent observations
within_cell_detrending: Subtract separate linear cycle fits from QD and signal before residual Pearson.
qd_qc_ratio: QD/QCharge summary ratio, not a validated high-precision coulombic efficiency diagnosis
p_values: omitted; exploratory many comparisons, autocorrelation and confounding
reaches_label: k+window >= provided life; after_label uses strict >; missing lives unknown, never imputed
role: Retrospective description, not mechanistic proof or predictive validation
